findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice mcqs for Chapter 7 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Biology Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 45 questions numbered 1-45; by section: 7.1 13, 7.2 10, 7.3 14, 7.4 8. Keys: {'a': 11, 'b': 11, 'c': 11, 'd': 12}.

Covers every section 7.1-7.4 in order: applications of structural biology (active sites and domains, drug targets, host-pathogen interactions, protein misfolding), X-ray crystallography and its steps, computational biology (areas, applications, databases, BLAST and FASTA), sequence and structural homology. The chapter is short, so the set is smaller. None repeats the chapter exercise. Book correction followed: the misfolding diseases are named cystic fibrosis, Parkinson's disease and Alzheimer's disease.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
